SELECT
  mr."Id" AS "McuResultId",
  mr."AttemptNo" AS "AttemptNo",
  mr."ResultStatus" AS "ResultStatus",
  mr."FitWithGlasses" AS "FitWithGlasses",
  mr."ResultDate" AS "ResultDate",
  mr."NextMcuDate" AS "NextMcuDate",
  mr."DoctorNotes" AS "DoctorNotes",
  mr."McuRegistrationId" AS "McuRegistrationId",
  r."Status" AS "RegistrationStatus",
  r."McuType" AS "McuType",
  r."RegistrationDate" AS "RegistrationDate",
  r."ScheduledDate" AS "ScheduledDate",
  r."ParticipantId" AS "ParticipantId",
  p."FullName" AS "ParticipantName",
  p."Nik" AS "Nik",
  r."HospitalName" AS "HospitalName",
  r."ClinicId" AS "ClinicId",

SELECT p."Id" AS "ParticipantId",
       p."FullName" AS "ParticipantName",
       p."Nik" AS "Nik",
       s."Code" AS "SiteCode",
       s."Name" AS "SiteName",
       pr."PermitType" AS "PermitType",
       pr."PermitNo" AS "PermitNo",
       pr."ExpiryDate" AS "ExpiryDate"
FROM "permits" pr
JOIN "participants" p
  ON p."Id" = pr."ParticipantId"
JOIN "sites" s
  ON s."Id" = p."SiteId"
WHERE pr."ExpiryDate" >= (CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone)
  AND pr."ExpiryDate" < ((CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '90 days')::timestamp with time zone)
ORDER BY pr."ExpiryDate" ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT "tp"."Id" AS "training_participant_id",
       "tp"."ParticipantId" AS "participant_id",
       "p"."FullName" AS "participant_name",
       "tp"."TrainingBatchId" AS "training_batch_id",
       "tb"."BatchNo" AS "training_batch_no",
       "tp"."ExamStatus" AS "exam_status",
       "tp"."PassedAt" AS "passed_at",
       "tp"."Score" AS "score",
       "tp"."AttendedAt" AS "attended_at"
FROM "training_participants" "tp"
JOIN "training_batches" "tb"
  ON "tb"."Id" = "tp"."TrainingBatchId"
JOIN "participants" "p"
  ON "p"."Id" = "tp"."ParticipantId"
ORDER BY "tp"."CreatedAt" DESC
LIMIT 100;

WITH company_permits AS (
  SELECT
    p."CompanyId" AS "CompanyId",
    COUNT(*) AS "PermitCount",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pe."Status" = 'ACTIVE') AS "ActivePermitCount",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pe."Status" = 'EXPIRED') AS "ExpiredPermitCount"
  FROM "permits" pe
  JOIN "participants" p ON p."Id" = pe."ParticipantId"
  GROUP BY p."CompanyId"
),
company_mcu AS (
  SELECT
    p."CompanyId" AS "CompanyId",
    COUNT(*) AS "McuRegistrationCount",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mr."Status" = 'COMPLETED') AS "McuCompletedCount",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mr."Status" = 'REGISTERED') AS "McuRegisteredCount"
  FROM "mcu_registrations" mr
  JOIN "participants" p ON p."Id" = mr."ParticipantId"
  GROUP BY p."CompanyId"
),
company_tags AS (
  SELECT
    p."CompanyId" AS "CompanyId",
    COUNT(*) AS "TagCount",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t."Status" = 1) AS "TagReleasedCount",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t."Status" <> 1) AS "TagNotReleasedCount"
  FROM "tags" t
  JOIN "participants" p ON p."Id" = t."ParticipantId"
  GROUP BY p."CompanyId"
)
SELECT
  c."Id" AS "CompanyId",
  c."Code" AS "CompanyCode",
  c."Name" AS "CompanyName",
  COALESCE(cp."PermitCount", 0) AS "PermitCount",
  COALESCE(cp."ActivePermitCount", 0) AS "ActivePermitCount",
  COALESCE(cp."ExpiredPermitCount", 0) AS "ExpiredPermitCount",
  COALESCE(cm."McuRegistrationCount", 0) AS "McuRegistrationCount",
  COALESCE(cm."McuCompletedCount", 0) AS "McuCompletedCount",
  COALESCE(cm."McuRegisteredCount", 0) AS "McuRegisteredCount",
  COALESCE(ct."TagCount", 0) AS "TagCount",
  COALESCE(ct."TagReleasedCount", 0) AS "TagReleasedCount",
  COALESCE(ct."TagNotReleasedCount", 0) AS "TagNotReleasedCount"
FROM "companies" c
LEFT JOIN company_permits cp ON cp."CompanyId" = c."Id"
LEFT JOIN company_mcu cm ON cm."CompanyId" = c."Id"
LEFT JOIN company_tags ct ON ct."CompanyId" = c."Id"
ORDER BY
  (COALESCE(cp."ActivePermitCount", 0) + COALESCE(cm."McuCompletedCount", 0) + COALESCE(ct."TagReleasedCount", 0)) DESC,
  c."Name" ASC
LIMIT 100;

WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS (
  SELECT
    "d"."Id" AS "DepartmentId",
    "d"."Id" AS "RootDepartmentId",
    "d"."Name" AS "DepartmentName",
    "d"."parent_id" AS "ParentId",
    0 AS "Depth"
  FROM "departments" "d"
  WHERE "d"."parent_id" IS NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    "c"."Id" AS "DepartmentId",
    "t"."RootDepartmentId" AS "RootDepartmentId",
    "c"."Name" AS "DepartmentName",
    "c"."parent_id" AS "ParentId",
    "t"."Depth" + 1 AS "Depth"
  FROM "dept_tree" "t"
  JOIN "departments" "c" ON "c"."parent_id" = "t"."DepartmentId"
),
emp_counts AS (
  SELECT
    "e"."DepartmentId" AS "DepartmentId",
    COUNT(*) AS "EmployeeCount"
  FROM (
    SELECT "ep"."DepartmentId" AS "DepartmentId"
    FROM "employee_profiles" "ep"
  ) "e"
  GROUP BY "e"."DepartmentId"
)
SELECT
  "dt"."DepartmentName" AS "DepartmentName",
  COALESCE(SUM("ec"."EmployeeCount"), 0) AS "EmployeeCount"
FROM "dept_tree" "dt"
LEFT JOIN "emp_counts" "ec" ON "ec"."DepartmentId" = "dt"."DepartmentId"
GROUP BY "dt"."RootDepartmentId", "dt"."DepartmentName"
ORDER BY "EmployeeCount" DESC, "DepartmentName" ASC
LIMIT 25;

results.question: Permit expiry timeline: count expiring per month, next 12 months.

citations.query_used:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT (DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) + (n || ' months')::interval)::date AS month_start,
         (DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) + ((n + 1) || ' months')::interval - INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS month_end
  FROM generate_series(0, 11) AS n
)
SELECT
  to_char(m.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS "month",
  COUNT(p."Id") AS "expiring_permit_count"
FROM months m
JOIN "permits" p
  ON p."ExpiryDate"::date BETWEEN m."month_start" AND m."month_end"
GROUP BY m.month_start
ORDER BY m.month_start
LIMIT 100;

results.question: Cumulative participant growth by month (running total).

citations.query_used:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', "CreatedAt")::date AS "month",
    COUNT(*) AS "new_participants"
  FROM "participants"
  GROUP BY 1
), running AS (
  SELECT
    "month",
    "new_participants",
    SUM("new_participants") OVER (ORDER BY "month" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "cumulative_participants"
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT
  "month",
  "new_participants",
  "cumulative_participants"
FROM running
ORDER BY "month"
LIMIT 100;

citations.query_used:
WITH pax AS (
  SELECT
    p."SiteId" AS "SiteId",
    COUNT(*) AS "TotalPax"
  FROM "participants" p
  GROUP BY p."SiteId"
),
active_permits AS (
  SELECT
    p."SiteId" AS "SiteId",
    COUNT(DISTINCT p."Id") AS "PaxWithActivePermits"
  FROM "permits" pr
  JOIN "participants" p ON p."Id" = pr."ParticipantId"
  WHERE pr."Status" = 'ACTIVE'
  GROUP BY p."SiteId"
),
fit_mcu AS (
  SELECT
    p."SiteId" AS "SiteId",
    COUNT(DISTINCT p."Id") AS "PaxWithFitMcu"
  FROM "mcu_results" r
  JOIN "mcu_registrations" mr ON mr."Id" = r."McuRegistrationId"
  JOIN "participants" p ON p."Id" = mr."ParticipantId"
  WHERE r."ResultStatus" IN ('FIT', 'FIT_WITH_GLASSES')
  GROUP BY p."SiteId"
),
passed_training AS (
  SELECT
    p."SiteId" AS "SiteId",
    COUNT(DISTINCT p."Id") AS "PaxWithPassedTraining"
  FROM "training_participants" tp
  JOIN "training_batches" tb ON tb."Id" = tp."TrainingBatchId"
  JOIN "participants" p ON p."Id" = tp."ParticipantId"
  WHERE tp."PassedAt" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p."SiteId"
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    pax."SiteId" AS "SiteId",
    pax."TotalPax" AS "TotalPax",
    COALESCE(ap."PaxWithActivePermits", 0) AS "PaxWithActivePermits",
    COALESCE(fm."PaxWithFitMcu", 0) AS "PaxWithFitMcu",
    COALESCE(pt."PaxWithPassedTraining", 0) AS "PaxWithPassedTraining"
  FROM pax
  LEFT JOIN active_permits ap ON ap."SiteId" = pax."SiteId"
  LEFT JOIN fit_mcu fm ON fm."SiteId" = pax."SiteId"
  LEFT JOIN passed_training pt ON pt."SiteId" = pax."SiteId"
)
SELECT
  s."Id" AS "SiteId",
  s."Code" AS "SiteCode",
  s."Name" AS "SiteName",
  c."TotalPax" AS "TotalPax",
  (c."PaxWithActivePermits" + c."PaxWithFitMcu" + c."PaxWithPassedTraining") AS "ComplianceNumerator",
  CASE
    WHEN c."TotalPax" = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE ROUND(
      (c."PaxWithActivePermits" + c."PaxWithFitMcu" + c."PaxWithPassedTraining")::numeric / c."TotalPax"::numeric,
      6
    )
  END AS "ComplianceScore"
FROM combined c
JOIN "sites" s ON s."Id" = c."SiteId"
ORDER BY "ComplianceScore" DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT c."Id" AS "CompanyId", c."Name" AS "CompanyName",
       COUNT(DISTINCT p."Id") AS "ParticipantsCount",
       COUNT(DISTINCT per."Id") FILTER (WHERE per."Status" = 'EXPIRED') AS "ExpiredPermitsCount",

LEFT JOIN "mcu_results" mcr ON mcr."McuRegistrationId" = mr."Id"
LEFT JOIN "tags" t ON t."ParticipantId" = p."Id" AND t."SiteId" = p."SiteId"
GROUP BY c."Id", c."Name"
ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT per."Id") FILTER (WHERE per."Status" = 'EXPIRED')
          + COUNT(DISTINCT mcr."Id") FILTER (WHERE mcr."ResultStatus" <> 'FIT')
          + COUNT(DISTINCT t."Id") FILTER (WHERE t."Status" = 0)) DESC

WITH expired_permits AS (
  SELECT
    p."ParticipantId" AS "ParticipantId",
    COUNT(*) AS "ExpiredPermitCount"
  FROM "permits" p
  WHERE p."Status" = 'EXPIRED'
  GROUP BY p."ParticipantId"
),
non_fit_mcu AS (
  SELECT
    r."McuRegistrationId" AS "McuRegistrationId",
    m."ParticipantId" AS "ParticipantId",
    COUNT(*) AS "NonFitMcuCount"
  FROM "mcu_results" r
  JOIN "mcu_registrations" m
    ON m."Id" = r."McuRegistrationId"
  WHERE r."ResultStatus" <> 'FIT'
  GROUP BY r."McuRegistrationId", m."ParticipantId"
),
weighted_tags AS (
  SELECT
    t."ParticipantId" AS "ParticipantId",
    COUNT(*) AS "TagCount"
  FROM "tags" t
  GROUP BY t."ParticipantId"
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(w."ParticipantId", e."ParticipantId", n."ParticipantId") AS "ParticipantId",
  COALESCE(w."TagCount", 0) AS "TagCount",
  COALESCE(e."ExpiredPermitCount", 0) AS "ExpiredPermitCount",
  COALESCE(n."NonFitMcuCount", 0) AS "NonFitMcuCount",
  (COALESCE(w."TagCount", 0) * 1.0
   + COALESCE(e."ExpiredPermitCount", 0) * 2.0
   + COALESCE(n."NonFitMcuCount", 0) * 3.0) AS "RiskIndex"
FROM weighted_tags w
FULL OUTER JOIN expired_permits e
  ON e."ParticipantId" = w."ParticipantId"
FULL OUTER JOIN non_fit_mcu n
  ON n."ParticipantId" = COALESCE(w."ParticipantId", e."ParticipantId")
ORDER BY "RiskIndex" DESC
LIMIT 100;

citations.query_used:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "mcu_results"."ResultDate")::int AS "year",
    COUNT(*) AS "total_attempts",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "mcu_results"."ResultStatus" = 'FIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "fit_attempts"
  FROM "mcu_results"
  GROUP BY 1
),
fit_pct AS (
  SELECT
    "year",
    ("fit_attempts"::numeric * 100.0 / NULLIF("total_attempts", 0)) AS "fit_percentage"
  FROM yearly
)
SELECT
  cur."year" AS "year",
  cur."fit_percentage" AS "fit_percentage",
  prev."fit_percentage" AS "fit_percentage_prev_year",
  (cur."fit_percentage" - prev."fit_percentage") AS "fit_percentage_yoy_change",
  CASE
    WHEN prev."fit_percentage" IS NULL OR prev."fit_percentage" = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ((cur."fit_percentage" - prev."fit_percentage") / prev."fit_percentage") * 100.0
  END AS "fit_percentage_yoy_change_pct"
FROM fit_pct cur
LEFT JOIN fit_pct prev
  ON prev."year" = cur."year" - 1
ORDER BY cur."year" DESC
LIMIT 100;

  COUNT(DISTINCT p."Id") AS "ParticipantCount",
  COUNT(DISTINCT tp."ParticipantId") FILTER (WHERE tp."Id" IS NOT NULL) AS "TrainingParticipantCount",

    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT tp."ParticipantId") / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p."Id"), 0),
    2
  ) AS "CoveragePercent"
FROM "departments" d
JOIN "employee_profiles" ep
  ON ep."DepartmentId" = d."Id"
JOIN "participants" p
  ON p."Id" = ep."ParticipantId"
LEFT JOIN "training_participants" tp
  ON tp."ParticipantId" = p."Id"
LEFT JOIN "training_batches" tb
  ON tb."Id" = tp."TrainingBatchId"
GROUP BY d."Id", d."Name"
ORDER BY "CoveragePercent" DESC, "TrainingParticipantCount" DESC
LIMIT 15;

  SELECT
    p."Id" AS "RootPermitId",
    p."Id" AS "PermitId",

    pc."RootPermitId",
    p2."Id" AS "PermitId",
    p2."RenewedFromPermitId" AS "PrevPermitId",
    pc."Depth" + 1 AS "Depth"
  FROM permit_chain pc
  JOIN "permits" p2
    ON p2."RenewedFromPermitId" = pc."PermitId"
)

  pc."RootPermitId",
  MAX(pc."Depth") AS "LongestDepth"
FROM permit_chain pc
GROUP BY pc."RootPermitId"
ORDER BY "LongestDepth" DESC
LIMIT 100;

With only these three months, the pattern suggests **weak-to-no correlation** (and possibly an inverse relationship in this small sample), but it’s also likely that **permit issuance is driven by factors other than hiring volume** (e.g., eligibility timing, processing backlogs, policy constraints, or cohort effects).

WITH batch_stats AS (
  SELECT
    it."Id" AS "InductionTypeId",
    it."Name" AS "InductionTypeName",
    COUNT(*) AS "TotalBatches",

    "InductionTypeId",
    "InductionTypeName",
    "TotalBatches",
    CASE
      WHEN "TotalModuleCount" = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE ("PassedModuleCount"::numeric / "TotalModuleCount"::numeric)
    END AS "CompletionRate"
  FROM batch_stats
)
SELECT
  "InductionTypeName" AS "InductionType",
  "CompletionRate" AS "AverageCompletionRate"
FROM ranked
ORDER BY "CompletionRate" DESC NULLS LAST

WITH newest_permit AS (
  SELECT p."Id" AS "PermitId",
         p."ParticipantId" AS "ParticipantId",
         p."IssueDate" AS "IssueDate"
  FROM "permits" p
  ORDER BY p."IssueDate" DESC, p."CreatedAt" DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  tp."ParticipantId" AS "ParticipantId",
  pr."FullName" AS "ParticipantName",
  tb."BatchNo" AS "TrainingBatchNo",
  tt."Code" AS "TrainingTypeCode",
  tt."Name" AS "TrainingTypeName",
  tp."Status" AS "TrainingStatus",
  tp."Score" AS "TrainingScore",
  tp."AttendedAt" AS "AttendedAt",
  tp."PassedAt" AS "PassedAt",
  tp."CertificateNo" AS "CertificateNo",
  tp."CertificateIssuedAt" AS "CertificateIssuedAt",
  tp."CertificateExpiryDate" AS "CertificateExpiryDate",
  tp."ExamStatus" AS "ExamStatus",
  tp."ExamAccessCode" AS "ExamAccessCode",
  tp."CreatedAt" AS "TrainingParticipantCreatedAt"
FROM newest_permit np
JOIN "training_participants" tp
  ON tp."ParticipantId" = np."ParticipantId"
JOIN "participants" pr
  ON pr."Id" = tp."ParticipantId"
LEFT JOIN "training_batches" tb
  ON tb."Id" = tp."TrainingBatchId"
LEFT JOIN "training_requests" tr
  ON tr."Id" = tp."TrainingRequestId"
LEFT JOIN "training_types" tt
  ON tt."Id" = tr."TrainingTypeId"
ORDER BY tp."AttendedAt" DESC NULLS LAST, tp."CreatedAt" DESC
LIMIT 100;
